title: Senator Mike Rounds says NO to UFO gatekeeper-assassin theories
summary: Douglas Dean Johnson published four negative written answers attributed to Senator Mike Rounds about alleged murders, physical threats and risks to prospective UAP informants. Responses transmitted June 17, 2026; published October 30, 2026. The underlying email correspondence was not independently obtained by GreyAlien.
evidence_status: Article and attributed responses reviewed; original private email correspondence not independently obtained
